summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Admin Ambassador Application Management features for 4Luis platform. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all action buttons and modals working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin login with correct credentials (admin@4luis.com / admin_password)
Backend: GET /api/admin/ambassador-journeys - list all ambassador applications
Backend: GET /api/admin/ambassador-journeys?status=candidatura - filter by status
Backend: GET /api/admin/ambassador-journeys/{journey_id}/details - full details with ambassador history
Backend: Details include journey data (name, poetic_name, description, goal_amount, status)
Backend: Details include ambassador profile and history (contributions, referrals, other journeys)
Backend: 404 returned for invalid journey ID on details endpoint
Backend: PUT /api/admin/ambassador-journeys/{id}/status with status='aprovada' and auto_activate=true
Backend: Approve changes status to 'ativa' (not just 'aprovada') when auto_activate=true
Backend: Response includes is_now_live=true and published_in='Sonhos em Materialização'
Backend: PUT /api/admin/ambassador-journeys/{id}/status with status='ajustes_pedidos'
Backend: Adjustment request message stored correctly
Backend: PUT /api/admin/ambassador-journeys/{id}/status with status='encerrada' (reject)
Backend: Invalid status values rejected with 400 error
Backend: Non-existent journey returns 404
Frontend: Candidaturas tab displays with correct badge count
Frontend: Status summary cards show all 7 statuses (candidatura, ajustes_pedidos, aprovada, ativa, financiada, realizada, encerrada)
Frontend: Application card shows journey details, ambassador info, dates, action buttons
Frontend: 'Ver Detalhes' button opens modal
Frontend: Details modal shows journey info, description, objective, destination, date, status
Frontend: Details modal shows 'Mensagem do Embaixador'
Frontend: Details modal shows 'Perfil do Embaixador' section with name, email, level
Frontend: Details modal shows 'Histórico de Contribuições' with total amount
Frontend: Details modal shows 'Referrals (Convites)' with valid count and list
Frontend: 'Aprovar e Ativar Viagem' button present in modal
Frontend: 'Pedir Ajustes' button opens adjustment request modal
Frontend: Adjustment modal has textarea and 'Enviar Pedido' button
Frontend: 'Rejeitar' button present
critical_code_review_comments: All requested features are fully implemented and working correctly
Auto-activate on approval works as expected - status changes directly to 'ativa'
Email integration is configured (RESEND_API_KEY present) and code sends emails on status changes
Details modal includes comprehensive ambassador history with contributions, referrals, and other journeys
Status workflow properly transitions between candidatura -> ativa (when auto_activate=true)
seed_data_used: Test application 'Aventura em Bali' (journey_554af031550c) with status 'candidatura'. Was created by main agent for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Candidaturas management features fully tested and working. Test application 'Aventura em Bali' reset to 'candidatura' status after testing. Key flows verified: List applications, View details with ambassador history, Approve+Activate (auto), Request adjustments, Reject. Email integration configured with Resend. Admin credentials: admin@4luis.com / admin_password

feature_1_lista_candidaturas.description: Lista de candidaturas no Admin com botão Ver Detalhes
feature_1_lista_candidaturas.details: Candidaturas tab shows list with Ver Detalhes, Aprovar e Ativar, Pedir Ajustes, Rejeitar buttons

feature_2_modal_detalhes.description: Modal de detalhes com: dados da viagem, perfil do embaixador, histórico de contribuições, referrals
feature_2_modal_detalhes.details: Modal includes: journey info, Mensagem do Embaixador, Perfil do Embaixador, Histórico de Contribuições (€0), Referrals (3 válidos)

feature_3_aprovar_candidatura.description: Aprovar candidatura - deve ativar viagem automaticamente e enviar email
feature_3_aprovar_candidatura.details: With auto_activate=true, status changes from 'candidatura' directly to 'ativa'. Response includes is_now_live=true and email_sent flag

feature_4_pedir_ajustes.description: Pedir Ajustes - deve mudar estado para 'ajustes_pedidos' e enviar email
feature_4_pedir_ajustes.details: Modal opens with textarea for adjustment request. Status changes to 'ajustes_pedidos' and message is stored

feature_5_rejeitar.description: Rejeitar candidatura - deve mudar estado para 'encerrada'
feature_5_rejeitar.details: Status changes to 'encerrada' and journey becomes inactive (is_active=false)

feature_6_endpoint_details.details: Returns journey, ambassador, and ambassador_history with contributions, referrals, and journeys_created

feature_7_endpoint_status.details: When status=aprovada and auto_activate=true, journey goes directly to 'ativa' status
